_comment: This file is the ORDER + PRESENTATION layer for vocabs.json.
vocabs.json is a JSON object, and JSON objects have no guaranteed key order once
decoded, so section order can never be derived from it reliably (note that 504's
'review_1' belongs between day_6 and day_7 — no sort function would guess that).
This file supplies the order, the display titles, and the intro/preview copy.
Adding a new day: append the words to vocabs.json, then add one entry here.
If you forget, the app still works — unlisted sections are appended at the end
with an auto-generated title ('day_9' -> 'Day 9') and no intro.
The 125 book is the hard list from the back of the 504 and has no days: its
sections are single letters in alphabetical order, and it is still being filled in.

books.title: 504 Absolutely Essential Words
books.author: Barron's
books.intro: The classic vocabulary builder. Twelve words a day, each one chosen because it shows up again and again in academic reading. Work through a day, let it settle, then come back — the checklist below every word tracks how well it is actually sticking.

sections.title: Day 1
sections.intro: Your first twelve. Words about character and promises — 'oath', 'tact', 'gallant' — plus a few that look easier than they are.

sections.title: Day 2
sections.intro: A darker set: cold, danger and things hidden. 'Corpse', 'peril' and 'sinister' turn up all through narrative passages.

sections.title: Day 3
sections.intro: Measurement and judgement — 'minimum', 'scarce', 'essential'. These appear in the test questions themselves, not only in the passages.

sections.title: Day 4
sections.intro: Weather and physical science: 'vapor', 'humid', 'dense', 'circulate'. Reading passages lean on this set constantly.

sections.title: Day 5
sections.intro: Campus and civic life — 'campus', 'majority', 'debate', 'reform'. Common in the conversation sections.

sections.title: Day 6
sections.intro: The last set before your first review. Work and honesty: 'employee', 'deceive', 'defraud'. If a word feels shaky, mark it wrong — it will come back sooner.

sections.title: Review 1
sections.intro: Eighteen words drawn from the ground you have covered, with no new extras. This one is purely about retention.

sections.title: Day 7
sections.intro: Back to new material. Several words here carry a formal register, and those are the ones that lift a writing score.

sections.title: Day 8
sections.intro: Judging quality and size: 'mediocre', 'prominent', 'bulky'. Each has a near-synonym you already know, and the difference is the whole point.

sections.title: Day 9
sections.intro: Time and place, plus words for giving up and holding on — 'vicinity', 'decade', 'resist', 'ignore'.

sections.title: Day 10
sections.intro: Competition: 'excel', 'compete', 'victorious', 'underestimate', with 'masculine' and 'feminine' alongside them.

sections.title: Day 11
sections.intro: Seeing and thinking — 'evidence', 'vision', 'glimpse', 'hesitate'. Short words with precise academic uses.

sections.title: Day 12
sections.intro: Cities and rules: 'urban', 'population', 'pollute', 'prohibit'. Eleven words — this day is one short in the book itself.

sections.title: Review 2
sections.intro: Ten words, no extras. A quick consolidation round before the next six days.

sections.title: Day 13
sections.intro: News and movement — 'journalist', 'migrate', 'revive', 'persist'. Verbs that often carry a lecture summary.

sections.title: Day 14
sections.intro: Conflict: 'rival', 'brutal', 'opponent', 'brawl'. Strong feelings, so the shades between them matter.

sections.title: Day 15
sections.intro: Growth and promises — 'expand', 'mature', 'pledge', 'unanimous'. Useful whenever you write about change.

sections.title: Day 16
sections.intro: Size, doubt and care: 'vast', 'capacity', 'accurate', 'cautious'. Precision words for describing evidence.

sections.title: Day 17
sections.intro: Need and risk — 'addict', 'wary', 'avoid', 'nourish'. 'Keg' is the odd one out; learn it and move on.

sections.title: Day 18
sections.intro: Streets and money: 'pedestrian', 'budget', 'reckless', 'economical'. Everyday nouns that carry academic weight.

sections.title: Review 3
sections.intro: Nine words, no extras. The shortest review in the book, so make the marks honest.

sections.title: Day 19
sections.intro: Food, numbers and limits — 'harvest', 'estimate', 'quota', 'ban'. Common around charts and data.

sections.title: Day 20
sections.intro: Survival: 'emerge', 'ambush', 'perish', 'devour'. Vivid verbs, easy to picture and easy to keep.

sections.title: Day 21
sections.intro: Agreement and trouble — 'collide', 'confirm', 'verify', 'dilemma'. 'Verify' and 'confirm' are not the same; read both.

sections.title: Day 22
sections.intro: Crime and family law: 'warden', 'justice', 'spouse', 'homicide'. Formal register throughout.

sections.title: Day 23
sections.intro: Rules and showing — 'forbid', 'logical', 'exhibit', 'proceed'. Several arrive with a fixed preposition.

sections.title: Day 24
sections.intro: Strong feeling: 'fierce', 'detest', 'sneer', 'scowl'. Four ways to show dislike, each one slightly different.

sections.title: Review 4
sections.intro: Ten words, no extras. Half the book is behind you.

sections.title: Day 25
sections.intro: Travel and ruin — 'architect', 'baggage', 'squander', 'calamity'. 'Matrimony' and 'bigamy' belong together.

sections.title: Day 26
sections.intro: Daring and calming: 'compel', 'venture', 'quench', 'pacify'. Verbs of pushing and of soothing.

sections.title: Day 27
sections.intro: Speed and thrift — 'rapid', 'rash', 'exhaust', 'thrifty', 'miserly'. 'Thrifty' is praise; 'miserly' is not.

sections.title: Day 28
sections.intro: Harm and law: 'outlaw', 'disclose', 'censor', 'culprit'. Common in argument passages.

sections.title: Day 29
sections.intro: Work and loss — 'toil', 'blunder', 'mourn', 'subside'. Quiet words, mostly from narrative.

sections.title: Day 30
sections.intro: Describing and naming: 'depict', 'novel', 'quote', 'verse'. 'Novel' as an adjective catches people out.

sections.title: Review 5
sections.intro: Only five words, no extras. Treat it as a warm-up rather than a day.

sections.title: Day 31
sections.intro: Travel and belief — 'commuter', 'patriotic', 'valor', 'lunatic'. Watch 'idle' and 'idol', which sound alike.

sections.title: Day 32
sections.intro: Less and more: 'diminish', 'maximum', 'flee', 'vulnerable'. Thirteen words — one over the usual twelve.

sections.title: Day 33
sections.intro: Voice and attitude — 'shrill', 'witty', 'mumble', 'mute'. Words for how people speak.

sections.title: Day 34
sections.intro: School and medicine: 'candidate', 'coeducational', 'vaccinate', 'temperate'. Long words, but regular ones.

sections.title: Day 35
sections.intro: Money and film — 'lottery', 'finance', 'cinema', 'soar'. 'Stationary' is not 'stationery'.

sections.title: Day 36
sections.intro: Heat and calm: 'scorch', 'tempest', 'soothe', 'harmony'. 'Resume' has two meanings; learn both.

sections.title: Review 6
sections.intro: Five words, no extras. The last of the short reviews.

sections.title: Day 37
sections.intro: Power and shortage — 'heir', 'majestic', 'dwindle', 'surplus', 'drought'.

sections.title: Day 38
sections.intro: Crowds and feeling: 'swarm', 'tumult', 'dejected', 'tyrant'. Strong images, useful in writing.

sections.title: Day 39
sections.intro: Clear and hidden — 'unearth', 'legible', 'transparent', 'contagious'. 'Clergy' and 'placard' are nouns worth picturing.

sections.title: Day 40
sections.intro: Health and the city: 'epidemic', 'obesity', 'ventilate', 'municipal'. Formal, and common in lectures.

sections.title: Day 41
sections.intro: Second chances — 'rehabilitate', 'parole', 'nominate', 'potential'. Most of this set comes from civic life.

sections.title: Day 42
sections.intro: The last day: 'maintain', 'endure', 'ponder', 'amend', 'ballot'. A fitting set to finish on.

sections.title: Review 7
sections.intro: Seventeen words to close the book, no extras. Nothing new here — just proof.

books.title: 125 Hard but Essential Words
books.author: Barron's
books.intro: The hard list from the back of the 504 — the words the book keeps for last. There are no days here: the list is alphabetical, so you take one letter at a time. It is still being filled in, and letters appear as they are written.

sections.title: A
sections.intro: Eleven words, 'abate' to 'avid'. 'Aegis' and 'adage' are rare but easy to remember once they land.

sections.title: B
sections.intro: Only four, and three of them open the same way — 'belligerent', 'benevolent', 'benign'. Read all three together.

sections.title: C
sections.intro: The biggest letter so far: fifteen words, 'cajole' to 'cursory'. 'Covert' and 'clandestine' are near twins.

sections.title: D
sections.intro: Five words about decline and pressure — 'decadent', 'dormant', 'duress'.

sections.title: E
sections.intro: Seven words, 'egotist' to 'expedite'. 'Exacerbate' and 'exhort' are worth extra passes.

books.title: 400 Must-Have Words for the TOEFL
books.author: McGraw-Hill
books.intro: Built around what the TOEFL actually tests, and grouped by subject rather than by difficulty — farming, geology, medicine, law, art. Ten words a day, weighted toward academic lectures and campus conversations. Shorter days than the 504, which makes this a good second pass later in a study session.

sections.title: Day 1
sections.intro: Farming and plants — 'cultivation', 'fertilize', 'irrigation', 'photosynthesis'.

sections.title: Day 2
sections.intro: Disasters: 'catastrophic', 'eruption', 'famine', 'flood', 'unleash'.

sections.title: Day 3
sections.intro: Evolution and change — 'adapt', 'evolve', 'inherent', 'migration', 'survive'.

sections.title: Day 4
sections.intro: The environment: 'contamination', 'deplete', 'emission', 'extinction', 'reservoir'.

sections.title: Day 5
sections.intro: Mathematics — 'denominator', 'exponentially', 'infinitesimal', 'proportion', 'sequence'.

sections.title: Day 6
sections.intro: Measurement and materials: 'accuracy', 'adjacent', 'compress', 'overlap', 'seep'.

sections.title: Day 7
sections.intro: Engineering and upkeep — 'corrode', 'implement', 'installation', 'maintenance', 'simulation'.

sections.title: Day 8
sections.intro: Physics and chemistry: 'combustion', 'component', 'nucleus', 'permeate', 'rotate'.

sections.title: Day 9
sections.intro: Research words — 'acquisition', 'anomaly', 'intervene', 'retrieve'. Nine words; this day is one short.

sections.title: Day 10
sections.intro: Religion and belief: 'agnostic', 'atheist', 'deify', 'ecclesiastical', 'pious'.

sections.title: Day 11
sections.intro: Illness and injury — 'decrepit', 'fatally', 'forensics', 'prognosis', 'wound'. Nine words.

sections.title: Day 12
sections.intro: Treatment: 'anesthesia', 'implant', 'inject', 'obese', 'procedure'.

sections.title: Day 13
sections.intro: The supernatural — 'astrological', 'divination', 'phantom', 'psychic'.

sections.title: Day 14
sections.intro: Culture and what it leaves behind: 'assimilate', 'cremation', 'folklore', 'fossilize', 'relic'.

sections.title: Day 15
sections.intro: Fairness and bias — 'biased', 'discriminate', 'oppress', 'paradigm', 'prejudiced'.

sections.title: Day 16
sections.intro: Education: 'curriculum', 'erudite', 'parochial', 'rigor', 'secular'.

sections.title: Day 17
sections.intro: War — 'allegiance', 'artillery', 'hierarchy', 'mobilize', 'strategic'.

sections.title: Day 18
sections.intro: Conquest and collapse: 'annex', 'apex', 'conquest', 'prevailing', 'violation'.

sections.title: Day 19
sections.intro: History and place — 'chronologically', 'longitude', 'milieu', 'Orwellian'.

sections.title: Day 20
sections.intro: Economics: 'commodity', 'equity', 'inflation', 'per capita', 'subsidy'.

sections.title: Day 21
sections.intro: Wealth and class — 'affluence', 'elite', 'impoverish', 'nobility', 'prestige'.

sections.title: Day 22
sections.intro: Property and risk: 'asset', 'hazardous', 'lease', 'liability', 'proprietor'.

sections.title: Day 23
sections.intro: Work and reward — 'compensate', 'incentive', 'industrious', 'marginal', 'resign'.

sections.title: Day 24
sections.intro: Trade: 'distill', 'haggle', 'merchant', 'prototype', 'shuttle'.

sections.title: Day 25
sections.intro: Politics — 'advocate', 'coalition', 'inaugurate', 'policy', 'poll'.

sections.title: Day 26
sections.intro: The courtroom: 'accuse', 'allegedly', 'convict', 'verdict', 'witness'.

sections.title: Day 27
sections.intro: Policing and watching — 'apprehend', 'implicate', 'seize', 'surveillance'.

sections.title: Day 28
sections.intro: Argument: 'analyze', 'hypothesize', 'inference', 'objectively', 'versus'.

sections.title: Day 29
sections.intro: Corruption — 'bribery', 'erode', 'integrity', 'scandal', 'unmask'.

sections.title: Day 30
sections.intro: Crime: 'abduction', 'coerce', 'detain', 'piracy', 'smuggle'.

sections.title: Day 31
sections.intro: Drugs and distortion — 'addictive', 'cartel', 'interdict', 'potent', 'subtly'.

sections.title: Day 32
sections.intro: Family: 'ancestral', 'descendant', 'kin', 'paternal', 'sibling'.

sections.title: Day 33
sections.intro: Friendship — 'affection', 'bond', 'clique', 'confide', 'solidarity'.

sections.title: Day 34
sections.intro: Love and conflict: 'devotion', 'dilemma', 'loyal', 'passion', 'reciprocity'.

sections.title: Day 35
sections.intro: Contempt — 'berate', 'despise', 'humiliation', 'obnoxious', 'vitriolic'. Harsh words with precise meanings.

sections.title: Day 36
sections.intro: Independence and fear: 'autonomy', 'dire', 'hover', 'novice', 'plummet'.

sections.title: Day 37
sections.intro: Young people — 'adolescent', 'delinquency', 'hedonistic', 'rebel', 'status quo'.

sections.title: Day 38
sections.intro: Art and seeing: 'abstract', 'depict', 'perspective', 'realism', 'spectrum'.

sections.title: Day 39
sections.intro: Writing and signs — 'ambiguous', 'connotation', 'decipher', 'phonetic', 'symbolic'.

sections.title: Day 40
sections.intro: Performance: 'cast', 'charismatic', 'gala', 'improvisation', 'skit'.

sections.title: Day 41
sections.intro: The last day: 'bulk', 'capricious', 'cumbersome', 'exotic', 'vanity'. A mixed set to finish on.
